speaker: Kimi K3
text: Answering the client first: a $10 IPO application doesn't really work — US IPOs need brokers with allocation access and Indian IPOs have a minimum lot of roughly Rs 14-15k, above your Rs 10,000 budget. On Reliance via Zerodha delivery, the costs table shows about 0.38% round-trip (STT, stamp duty, DP charge ~Rs 16 on sale), so the stock must rise ~0.4% just to break even, plus 20% short-term capital-gains tax if sold within a year. On car and battery stocks, note BAJAJ-AUTO just fell 7.6% today with RSI 21 — deeply oversold, but the Nifty is in a foreign-outflow slump, so catching it is timing risk, not value. On spotlight NVDA: fundamentals remain extraordinary — revenue +105.9% YoY, 66% operating margins, 58 buys vs 1 sell, and Cantor just reiterated Overweight with a $350 target — but insiders sold $1.37B in six months with zero buys, which is the one fundamental crack in the story.
